statement: With the owner keeping a finger on the right pad, all 4470 reports with right-stick touch asserted across center/inner-edge comparison sequences had right-pad touch clear and right-pad X/Y/pressure zero. Pad reporting returned when stick touch cleared. Initial center pad-only window includes early stick contact noted by the owner. Suppression is already in the received USB input payload; whether firmware defaults or a Steam-configured rule enabled it is not isolated. Left-pad independence is an owner UI observation, not tested by a simultaneously active left pad in this capture. No exact geometric dead-zone percentage is established. The owner later showed Steam's per-side Trackpad Lockout controls, both enabled in the displayed view. Treat this as configuration-dependent behavior, not an immutable controller property. Disabled-setting behavior and the feature setting that programs this policy were not measured.
